# Google Search Console (GSC) MCP Server

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Google Search Console organic search analytics, keyword positions, URL inspection, and sitemaps.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx google-search-console-mcp`
- NPX: `npx -y google-search-console-mcp`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://gsc.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://gsc.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `get_search_analytics(site_url, start_date, end_date, dimensions, row_limit)`: Queries clicks, impressions, CTR, position.
- `list_sites()`: Lists verified sites.
- `inspect_url(site_url, inspection_url)`: Live URL indexing diagnostic.
- `list_sitemaps(site_url)`: Lists sitemaps.
- `submit_sitemap(site_url, feedpath)`: Submits new sitemap.
- `delete_sitemap(site_url, feedpath)`: Deletes sitemap.

## Environment Variables
- `GSC_SITE_URL`: Default verified property URL.
- `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`: Path to service account JSON key file.
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
